cards.text: Here's where we are, friend. Haman, the king's top official (Esther 3:1), had a decree written in King Xerxes' name and sealed with the king's ring: on one single day, the thirteenth of Adar, every Jew in the kingdom is to be destroyed (Esther 3:12-13). And now Mordecai, the Jew who wouldn't bow to Haman (Esther 3:2, 4), learns of all that has happened.

cards.question: Mordecai has just learned about the decree against all the Jews. What does he do?

answers.text: He tears his clothes and puts on sackcloth
He goes straight to Haman's house to argue
He locks himself inside his home to hide

cards.text: Then Mordecai goes out into the middle of the city, wailing loudly and bitterly. I think his heart is breaking, friend.

cards.question: Mordecai, still in his sackcloth, goes only as far as the king's gate. Why does he stop there?

answers.text: The law kept anyone in sackcloth out
The guards were under Haman's orders
Esther had told him to wait right there

cards.text: Meanwhile, the king's command and edict are going out to every province in the kingdom.

cards.question: In every province the king's decree reaches, the Jews ___, weep and lament, and many lie in sackcloth and ashes.

cards.text: Over in the palace, Esther's maidens and eunuchs come and tell her about Mordecai. Esther is the queen, and Mordecai is the cousin who took her in as his own daughter (Esther 2:7).

cards.question: Queen Esther is overcome with distress about Mordecai. What does she send out to him?

answers.text: Clothes to wear instead of sackcloth
Silver to help him leave the city
A message telling him to go home

cards.question: Mordecai takes the clothes Esther sent and changes out of his sackcloth.

cards.text: Mordecai won't accept them. Then Esther summons Hathach, one of the king's eunuchs appointed to her, and dispatches him out to Mordecai.

cards.question: Queen Esther sends Hathach out to Mordecai to find out what is troubling him and why.

cards.text: Hathach finds Mordecai in the city square in front of the king's gate. And Mordecai tells him all that has happened to him.

cards.question: Mordecai tells Hathach everything about Haman's plan, right down to one exact detail. What is it?

answers.text: How much money Haman promised to pay
How many soldiers Haman would send
Who else helped Haman plan it all

cards.question: Mordecai doesn't just talk to Hathach. He hands him something to show and explain to Esther. What is it?

answers.text: A copy of the written decree

cards.question: Mordecai urges Queen Esther to go to the king and plead with him for her people.

cards.text: So Hathach goes back and relays Mordecai's response to Esther. If you've ever been stuck carrying messages back and forth between two coworkers, friend, you know EXACTLY how Hathach's feet feel.
Hathach, lace those sandals back up, buddy, because Esther has an answer for Mordecai. And her answer starts with a law everybody in the kingdom knows.

cards.question: Esther says one law applies to anyone who approaches the king in the inner court without being summoned. What does it say happens to them?

answers.text: They are sent out of Susa

cards.text: Esther says there's one way out: that person lives only if the king holds out his gold scepter.

Then Esther adds that she has not been summoned to appear before the king for the past thirty days. I spent YEARS in a junk drawer waiting for somebody to reach in for me, so trust me, friend, I know a thing or two about waiting to get called.
Esther's words are relayed to Mordecai. And Mordecai sends a reply back to her.

cards.question: Mordecai warns Queen Esther not to imagine something. What is it?

answers.text: That the palace will keep her safe
That the king will forget his decree
That Haman will change his mind

cards.question: Mordecai tells Esther that if she stays silent, the Jews will have no other hope of rescue.
Mordecai warns that if Esther stays silent, she and her father's house will ___.
Mordecai ends his reply to Esther with a question. What is he asking her to consider?

answers.text: Maybe she became queen for this very moment
Maybe the king never really trusted her
Maybe she was never meant to be queen

cards.text: Whew, that question LANDS, friend. Then Esther sends her reply to Mordecai, and this time the queen is the one giving the instructions.

cards.question: Esther tells Mordecai to gather all the Jews who can be found in Susa. What does she ask them to do for her?

answers.text: Fast for her for three days
Write a plea to the king

cards.question: Esther says that she and her ___ will fast just as the Jews in Susa do.
After the three days of fasting, Esther says she will go to the king, even though it is against the law.

cards.text: Then Esther says it: "And if I perish, I perish!" I think that took every ounce of courage she had, friend.

cards.question: Mordecai goes and does all that Queen Esther instructed him.

cards.text: And that's where we'll leave it for now, friend. Mordecai's got his marching orders, and this story is FAR from over.
